correctness.rationale: On the positive-payoff domain, log F is strictly concave and hence any KKT optimizer is globally unique. Equalizing logarithmic marginals gives w_i exp(-x_i)=tau for active branches and w_i<=tau for inactive ones; the common-trunk condition gives exp(x_0)=W_k/tau-(k-1). The budget yields one strictly monotone root, whose tau decreases with B, creating exact nonreversing B_j activation boundaries. For k>=2, exp(x_0)-exp(x_1)=sum_{i=2}^k(w_i/tau-1)>0. For infinitely many geometric weights the finite-support KKT candidate globally dominates finite-support allocations by concavity, and approximation plus finite total weight extends this to all summable allocations. The B_j logarithmic expansion yields k(B)~sqrt(2B/(-log q)). Supplemental standard-library checker.py passed 39,710 finite tests; proof rather than tests establishes universal quantifiers.

originality.rationale: The closest detailed fish-passage source, King and O'Hanley (2014), handles priced discrete barrier projects through mixed-integer programming with nonzero partial passability; our exact statement is for a continuously divisible improvement curve with an arbitrary ordered terminal-habitat vector and a multiplicative shared downstream bottleneck. The 2017 and 2023 primary ecological formulations likewise do not state the strict sequential branch activation thresholds, downstream effort dominance or the infinite geometric square-root growth law. Kettelle (1962), read directly at pp. 261–262, instead optimizes a sum of exponential series-stage unavailabilities and bounds the difference from system unreliability. Generic convex optimization/water-filling is prior technique; the new contribution is the exact rooted-tributary geometry and asymptotic. These are best-knowledge comparisons, not an exhaustive historical-priority certification.
residual_risks: Continuous nonlinear resource-allocation monographs or an older series–parallel reliability theorem might contain an equivalent normal form not found in bounded searches.
A scientific model with unrestricted costs and passability curves need not inherit these exact thresholds; no such broader claim is made.
Ecological application requires empirical calibration; the model is an idealized benchmark, not a field prescription.

value.rationale: A natural habitat-connectivity payoff with a common downstream bottleneck and arbitrarily many terminal branches is not separable across barriers. The result turns its nontrivial coupled optimization into an exact single-root global design, with strict support-threshold ordering, downstream effort dominance, all tie conventions, and a square-root count of activated branches for geometric habitat-weight tails. It supplies a quantitative benchmark for restoration-planning algorithms and clarifies bottleneck versus diversification resource use. It is substantially more than computing a single ad hoc numerical optimum.
